svg.title: Workflow 3: Certificates to remedial quotes, same day
svg.text: Certificates to remedial quotes, same day
The landlord gets the report, a plain-English summary and a price for every fix, before the electrician gets home.
C1 alert now · C2, FI quoted · C3
From Jordan’s fix list in ServiceM8
On his phone, he knows the property
Example: 14 Elmore Road, flat 2 · Castlegate Lettings
Required: £665 + VAT · optional: £95 · sent 16:52, same day as the test
13 weeks: remedial quotes out in a median 0.4 days (was 8). 99% quoted (was 75%). 98.6% of 1,214 observations read right first time; the rest fixed by the inspector before sending.
Sign, change or issue a certificate
Decide a code: it copies the inspector’s
Alerts Craig and Jordan to any C1
Keeps the PDF exactly as issued
PDF unreadable: it goes to Lisa as before
Codes don’t add up: flagged, not sent
